listing.name: Ceres' Modyard
listing.summary: Adds four bizarre ships and repainted vanilla weapon sprites.
listing.aiSummary: Adds four bizarre ships and repainted vanilla weapon sprites.

description:
Ceres' Modyard

After making a ship-pack I decided this thread would be best served as a collection for all my various small mods that I make on a whim - for now, just a small ship pack and my weapon sprites, but I honestly have no idea what I might feel like doing at any given point. We'll see where it goes.

Four bizarre ships, sprites that were first made as a joke but found themselves becoming real. Not necessarily good ships, not necessarily balanced, but they are certainly ships. You can, at the very least, say that they are ships. As salvage retrofits, you will find them in Independent and Pirate fleets and, rarely, for sale in Black Markets or on Independent worlds. Although they have fairly unassuming statlines, they do boast some seriously concerning weapon-mount arrangements - and are equally prone to overfluxing if equipped without due restraint.

Download link:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1t37wa-5bM_NjO2GFsPUI3vk3xtitLDPx/view?usp=drive_link

It's very simple - some repainted sprites of a few vanilla weapons according to my personal taste. Some are very light touchups of the original design, others less so. I may or may not add more in future, whims depending.

Download link:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zziiHueTnYvILh_YsScVNt7z_PZN3n-R/view?usp=drive_link
